<a id="page-navigation"></a>
# Navigation and overlays

Page frames (Page, Section, Nav, App, Sidebar…), screens and going between them, dialogs, sheets, drawers, menus,
popovers, lightboxes, toasts, app bars and tabs. Open it when a UI has more than one screen, a frame, or anything
over the page.

<a id="navigation-page-frames"></a>
## Page frames

A page is written once inside a frame that owns the widths, margins and scrolling. A website's bands stack in a
`Page`; an app window is an `App` of panes. The frame words: `App`, `AppBar`, `AppShell`, `Aside`, `BottomSheet`, `Brand`, `Content`, `Dialog`, `Dots`, `Drawer`, `Dropdown`, `Footer`, `Header`, `Heading`, `Hero`, `IconTile`, `Lightbox`, `Link`, `Logo`, `Main`, `Menu`, `MenuItem`, `Modal`, `Nav`, `NavBar`, `NavItem`, `NavLink`, `Navbar`, `Page`, `Pane`, `Panel`, `Popover`, `Popup`, `Rail`, `Section`, `Sheet`, `SideNav`, `Sidebar`, `SidebarItem`, `Sidenav`, `SwipeAction`, `Title`, `TopBar`, `Topbar`, `Wanted`, `Window`.

```notation width=1280 expands
  Nav
    Brand "Tidewater" icon="waves"
    Link "Pricing"
  Section
    Heading "Fill every room" level=1
  Footer
    Text.muted "© 2026"
```

<a id="navigation-a-sidebar"></a>
### A sidebar

Write a sidebar with its own words and it is finished without styling: `Brand "Name" "line under it" icon="…"` at
its head; `NavSection "People & access"` over a group of items (small spaced capitals in a quiet ink, with room over
it); `NavItem "Members" icon="group"` for each item, with `selected={…}` for the chosen one (the accent and a tint
of it; the others share one ink and tint under the pointer), `badge="4"` for a count and `shortcut="Alt 1"` for a
key shown at its end; and `Footer` for what stays at the sidebar's end whatever is above it (the signed-in person,
help, shortcuts): the lines under it are pinned there, with a rule over them. In a column written by hand, a
`Spacer` (or an empty `box grow`) between two lines pushes the second to the end, as `margin-top: auto` does on the
web; the column needs a height (`h=fill`).

```notation width=1280 expands
state tab="members"
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Tenant" "Admin console" icon="hub"
    NavSection "People & access"
    NavItem "Members" icon="group" selected={tab=="members"} onTap={tab="members"} shortcut="Alt 1"
    NavItem "Teams" icon="groups" badge="4" selected={tab=="teams"} onTap={tab="teams"}
    NavSection "Workspace"
    NavItem "Billing" icon="credit_card" selected={tab=="billing"} onTap={tab="billing"}
    Footer
      NavItem "Keyboard shortcuts" icon="keyboard" shortcut="?"
  Main
    Text "Members"
```

A desktop window of three panes: a rail, the content, an inspector. `Sidebar` is the rail (`w=72` for icons only),
`Main` takes the room left and scrolls, each `Pane` is a further column as tall as the window (`w=` its width, else
it shares the room). Lines at the top of a `Main` or a `Pane` written `sticky` (its toolbar) are its head: they
stay above while the rest scrolls under them, never over it. A line in it that takes the room left (`grow`,
`h=fill`: a board's lanes, a list that scrolls itself) makes the pane a plain column that does not scroll. A key
with a size before it changes a pane at that width ([responsive.md](responsive.md)):
here the inspector leaves at a tablet's width and the rail at a phone's.

```notation width=1280 expands
state tab="inbox"
App
  Sidebar w=72 hide=phone
    NavItem "Inbox" icon="inbox" selected={tab=="inbox"} onTap={tab="inbox"}
    NavItem "Sent" icon="send" selected={tab=="sent"} onTap={tab="sent"}
  Main
    Text.title "Inbox"
  Pane w=320 hide=tablet
    Text.heading "Details"
```

It reads as:

```notation width=1280

Row stretch h=fill
  Column gap=2 pad=[12,16,12,12] w=72 h=fill border-right=#FFE5E7EB hide=phone

      Icon "inbox" color={(tab=="inbox")?"#FF2563EB":"#FF6B7280"} size=18
      Text "Inbox" grow weight={(tab=="inbox")?600:500} color={(tab=="inbox")?"#FF2563EB":"#FF374151"}

      Icon "send" color={(tab=="sent")?"#FF2563EB":"#FF6B7280"} size=18
      Text "Sent" grow weight={(tab=="sent")?600:500} color={(tab=="sent")?"#FF2563EB":"#FF374151"}
  Column scroll h=fill grow
    Text.title "Inbox"
  Column scroll w=320 h=fill border-right=#FFE5E7EB hide=tablet
    Text.heading "Details"
```

A `Splitter` between two panes lets the reader resize one. It keeps that pane's width in a variable (`@listW`) and
the pane reads it (`w={listW}`); with `pane=after` the variable is the width of the pane after it (an inspector at
the window's end), so dragging toward the end narrows that pane. It is as tall as the row it is in, a hairline in a
desktop window (8 px to grab, a grip under the pointer or the keyboard's focus); where the pane beside it draws its
own border on that side, that border is the line and the splitter draws none. Arrows, Home and End move it.

```notation width=1280 expands
state listW=360
state inspectorW=320
App
  Pane w={listW} border-right=line
    Text.heading "Messages"
  Splitter @listW min=280 max=520 label="Resize the list"
  Main
    Text.title "Reading"
  Splitter @inspectorW min=240 max=480 pane=after label="Resize the details"
  Pane w={inspectorW} border-left=line
    Text.heading "Details"
```

It reads as:

```notation width=1280
state listW=360
state inspectorW=320
Row stretch h=fill
  Column scroll h=fill border-right=line w={listW}
    Text.heading "Messages"
  Splitter "Resize the list" h=fill @listW min=280 max=520
  Column scroll h=fill grow
    Text.title "Reading"
  Splitter "Resize the details" h=fill @inspectorW min=240 max=480 pane=after
  Column scroll h=fill border-left=line w={inspectorW}
    Text.heading "Details"
```

<a id="navigation-over-the-page"></a>
## Over the page

An overlay is written after the page, at the margin, with an id; its content is indented under it. `open id`
shows it, `close` closes it (so does a tap outside it). `Dialog` (centered, a title and a close button), `Sheet`
(from the bottom; `stops=[0.5,0.9]`), `Drawer` (a side panel; `right`), `Menu` (by the button that opened it;
`MenuItem` lines), `Popover` (a small panel; `preview=id` on a line opens it on hover), `Lightbox` (a picture or a
gallery over the page). A `MenuItem` is its label, `icon=`, `onTap={…}` and, to name it in a render step, an id
(`MenuItem#dup "Duplicate" icon=content_copy onTap={…}`).

```notation width=1280 expands
Column gap=12
  Button "Join" onTap={open signup}
Dialog#signup "Join the waitlist"
  Button "Close" onTap={close}
```

It reads as:

```notation width=1280
Column gap=12
  Button "Join" onTap={open signup}
Dialog#signup "Join the waitlist"
  Button "Close" maxWidth=240 onTap={close} max479.w={"fill":0,"hug":null} max479.grow max479.layout.constraints.maxWidth=null
```

A Dialog, Sheet or Drawer that must not close while something is typed says so on its line: `guard={dirty}` (or
`blockBack={dirty}`) keeps Escape, a tap outside and back from closing it while it holds; `guardText="Discard the
draft?"` asks that first (a yes runs `onDiscard={…}` and closes); `onBackPressed={open keepDraft}` runs instead.
With no design system the panel is drawn in the theme's `surface` and its title in `onSurface`, so it follows the
site's theme and its dark mode; a `Drawer` has no rule at its side unless its line writes a `border`. For example
`Dialog#compose "New message" guard={draft != ""} guardText="Discard the draft?" onDiscard={draft=""}`.

<a id="navigation-screens"></a>
## Screens

Another canvas of the document is a `Canvas#id` block at the margin after the page, its tree under it; `go id`
opens it. The page's own canvas is the `canvas` line ([document.md](document.md)).

```notation
Column
  Button "About" onTap={go about}
Canvas#about "About" path="about"
  Text "About us"
```

### `appBar` (`appBar`)

Flutter `AppBar` (its toolbar height is the node height).

- Written `appBar`. Level 1 (Widget catalog).
- `appBar "…"` sets `props.title`; it takes one quoted string (a second is said).
- Takes no lines under it.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): only `effects` (blurs).
- The fields of its text style ([TextStyle](theme.md#type-TextStyle)) are keys by their own names: `letterSpacing=0.4`, `fontFamily="Inter"`.

<a id="navigation-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onLoad`](events.md#trigger-load), [`onBackPressed`](events.md#trigger-backPressed).
- Actions: [`navigate`](events.md#action-navigate), [`openModal`](events.md#action-openModal), [`closeModal`](events.md#action-closeModal), [`showToast`](events.md#action-showToast), [`announce`](events.md#action-announce), [`confirm`](events.md#action-confirm), [`openLink`](events.md#action-openLink).

<a id="navigation-records"></a>
## Records

<a id="type-NavigationDestination"></a>
### NavigationDestination

A navigation bar item: Flutter's `NavigationDestination` (and `BottomNavigationBarItem`). Icon colors are the item's own, over the bar's. `actions` are its reactions.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | text | `""` |  |
| `icon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) | `{}` |  |
| `iconColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `selectedIcon` | [IconData](values.md#type-IconData) |  |  |
| `selectedIconColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  |  |
| `tooltip` | text |  |  |
| `backgroundColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | `BottomNavigationBarItem.backgroundColor` (shifting bars). |
| `actions` | list of JSON | `[]` |  |

<a id="type-RouteTransition"></a>
### RouteTransition

A composable route transition. `enter` is where the incoming screen starts, `exit` where the covered one ends; closing plays them in reverse unless `popEnter` (where the screen revealed by the pop starts) or `popExit` (where the closing screen goes) are given. A `preset` fills in what's left null. JSON: an object, or a bare preset name.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | [RouteTransitionPreset](values.md#enum-RouteTransitionPreset) |  | A ready-made transition; the sides given override its own. |
| `enter` | [TransitionSide](values.md#type-TransitionSide) |  | Where the incoming screen starts. |
| `exit` | [TransitionSide](values.md#type-TransitionSide) |  | Where the covered screen ends. |
| `popEnter` | [TransitionSide](values.md#type-TransitionSide) |  | Null: exit reversed. |
| `popExit` | [TransitionSide](values.md#type-TransitionSide) |  | Null: enter reversed. |
| `durationMs` | whole number |  | Null: the preset's (300). |
| `reverseDurationMs` | whole number |  | Null: `durationMs`. |
| `barrierColor` | [Color](values.md#type-Color) |  | Drawn behind a modal (or a see-through page) while it's open. Null: none on pages, the dialog's own on modals. |
| `opaque` | `true`/`false` |  | Whether the screen hides the one below once open. Null: the preset's (true without one). |
| `swipeBack` | `platform` `always` `never` |  | Null: the preset's (`RouteSwipeBack.platform` without one). |
| `dismiss` | [RouteDismiss](#type-RouteDismiss) |  | A drag that closes the screen. |

<a id="type-RouteDismiss"></a>
### RouteDismiss

A drag anywhere on a screen that closes it interactively: the drag runs the transition backwards, and on release the pop completes or cancels with `spring`.

A record: written whole as JSON (`key={…}`), or field by field as dotted keys under the key that holds it (`key.field=…`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `direction` | `left` `right` `up` `down` | `down` | The way the screen is dragged to close it. |
| `distance` | number | `0.25` | The share of the screen's size along `direction` a slow drag must pass. |
| `velocity` | number | `700` | A fling faster than this (px/s) toward `direction` closes it. |
| `spring` | [Spring](values.md#type-Spring) | `{}` |  |

## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="navigation-example-navigation-json"></a>
### navigation.json

From [`navigation.json`](../navigation.md).

```notation
canvas "Home" h=844
Column#homeCol gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844}
  Button.ghost#toAbout "About us" w=160 h=40 onTap={go about}
  Button.ghost#openSignup "Sign up" w=160 h=40 onTap={openModal to=signup presentation=dialog}
  Button.ghost#toast "Show a toast" w=160 h=40 onTap={showToast message=Saved style=success}
Canvas#about "About" path="about" h=844 fill=#FFF9FAFB
  Column#aboutCol gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":844}
    Text.heading2#aboutTitle "About" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":30}
    Button.ghost#back "Back" w=120 h=40 onTap={navigate mode=pop}
Canvas#signup "Sign up" w=320 h=200 decoration.radius=16
  Column#signupCol gap=16 pad=24 w={"fill":320} h={"fill":200} crossAxisAlignment=null
    Text.title#signupTitle "Join the waitlist" weight=700 w={"hug":200} h={"hug":26}
    Button#close "Close" w=120 h=40 onTap={close}
```
